notes.title: Black Raven in the 2025 ANZ Games Fest
notes.notes: [p][i]Black Raven[/i] takes flight at the ANZ 2025 Steam Festival. A Ukrainian indie game currently being developed in Brisbane, Australia, it plunges players into 14th-century Eastern Europe, where Ivan, a broken father, becomes the Black Raven after raiders destroy his family. With a mix of Slavic folklore, plague-ridden landscapes, and brutal combat, [i]Black Raven[/i] is a 2.5D dark action-adventure that blends grim pixel art with heavy metal undertones. From cursed forests to ruined castles, every step is soaked in despair and vengeance. Wishlist now and experience a tale where history, myth, and sorrow collide on the ANZ stage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290869/15e8d234b944e8e7cc2222f97c30add0eac2fc21.png"][/img][/p]
